In particular we give a full description of the co-homology Groups of these groups as well as provide some interesting relationships between spectral sequences and associated functionors and between co-homological functionors and extensions of Groups.
In a more general context we Prove Some Abstract Existence and Regularity Theorems for Spectral sequences of a Group and give a number of useful examples, which include must know examples. Finally We discuss some Further Interesting Classes in Compararon to Other More Specialized and Complete Approaches.
